summary:
Rocket Forge is an educational space mission design game that allows players to experience the process of becoming rocket engineers. Players must complete five missions involving mining and refining materials, producing rocket fuel, designing heat shields, creating superalloys and manufacturing computer chips. After collecting the necessary materials, they can build and customise their own rockets to achieve orbit.
The game addresses the challenge by introducing players to the scientific and engineering knowledge required for successful space missions. Through interactive missions, players learn about rocket materials, propulsion systems, heat protection and flight computers. They must also make important decisions and solve problems to ensure their rockets can launch successfully.
This game is important because it makes space science more interesting and accessible to students. It encourages critical thinking, creativity and problem-solving while developing an understanding of real-world space technology. It also inspires young people to explore space science and consider careers in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM).
details:
Rocket Forge is an interactive space mission design game that allows players to experience the exciting world of rocket engineering and space exploration.
Players begin by completing missions to collect materials needed to build their own rockets. They must learn about different rocket components, understand their functions and solve engineering challenges. Once their rockets are ready, players can launch them into space and explore different destinations, including the Moon, Venus and Mars. During their missions, players collect soil samples before safely returning to Earth.
Our game features realistic environments and Minecraft-style gameplay, allowing players to explore, interact with objects and complete missions through hands-on experiences. Instead of simply reading information, players learn by solving problems and experiencing different challenges.
Rocket Forge aims to make STEM education more interesting and accessible, especially for students who are curious about space. It encourages critical thinking, creativity and problem-solving skills while introducing basic concepts of rocket construction and space exploration.
By combining education with interactive gameplay, we hope to inspire the next generation of space explorers, scientists and engineers.
